ops.parking: The hotel has an underground car park with 187 spaces (height limit 2.1 m). For banquet and wedding guests' parking, the official guidance is "please inquire". The overtime fee is 550 yen per 30 minutes. For security, the car park exit is closed from 23:30 to 6:30 the next day; to leave during this time, speak to the front desk or use the call button at the exit. For overnight guests, 2,000 yen per night (up to 24 hours).
ops.catering: For food hygiene management, the hotel officially asks that food and drinks brought in not be cooked or warmed in a microwave, and not be processed or served (cut, plated, etc.). Banquet plans come with food and free-flow drinks. The HILTON PARTY PLAN (October 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027) is a buffet at 15,000 yen per person or a course at 17,000 yen per person, with a 2-hour limit, up to 200 guests, and Pegasus is not available (tax included, service charge included).
ops.restaurants: The in-house restaurants are Seascape Terrace Dining, LE CHOU CHOU (Sweets & Deli), Japanese cuisine, teppanyaki, sushi and tempura at "Sakura", Captains Bar, Grillogy Bar & Grill, Chinese Cuisine "Choryumon", and room service. For company events and social gatherings, the HILTON PARTY PLAN and the ODAIBA PARTY PLAN WINTER 2026 (for year-end and New Year parties) are offered.
ops.waitingRooms: The small banquet rooms (Fuji, Ran, Hagi, Momo, Sumire, Tsubaki, Ume and Kiku on the 1F, 35 to 40㎡) are officially described as close to the large and medium banquet rooms and suitable for breakout rooms and waiting rooms. Rooms that get natural light can also be used as VIP waiting rooms.
